meta.title: Edge of Catastrophe
meta.description: The memories splinter, pouring forth an endless stream of mystery that flows toward the corrupted throne.

units.rawText: In the Admin Center of the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: With Neumann's assistance, Antonina is attempting to contact the other neural cloud hidden in Eosphorus' fragment in the hopes of pinpointing the Professor's location.

units.rawText: The neural net is now unpacking and separating the enmeshed data while the neural cloud pattern is under construction. How are things on your end, Anna?

units.rawText: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

spans.text: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

units.rawText: Although we just discovered the two of them have a very similar base framework, I've found more and more similarities between the fundamental data of both neural clouds the deeper I look.
units.displayText: Although we just discovered the two of them have a very similar base framework, I've found more and more similarities between the fundamental data of both neural clouds the deeper I look.

units.rawText: It's as though they came from the same template, but ended up developing in different ways due to the experiences they went through... It's like finding apples and pears on the same tree.
units.displayText: It's as though they came from the same template, but ended up developing in different ways due to the experiences they went through... It's like finding apples and pears on the same tree.

units.rawText: Hm... So it's a pear-apple?

units.rawText: Ahem... Or rather, they're like human twins.
units.displayText: Ahem... Or rather, they're like human twins.

units.rawText: (Sucks in breath) That's troublesome. Their code was already closely interlocked to begin with, and considering their similar characteristics...

units.rawText: Trying to quantify the differences between them is like separating a pool of water from more water.
units.displayText: Trying to quantify the differences between them is like separating a pool of water from more water.

spans.text: Trying to quantify the differences between them is like separating a pool of water from more water.

units.rawText: Let's install a backdoor program for analysis purposes. We need more data to isolate their differences... hm?

spans.text: Let's install a backdoor program for analysis purposes. We need more data to isolate their differences... hm?

units.rawText: I have one piece of bad news and two pieces of good news. Which do you want to hear first?
units.displayText: I have one piece of bad news and two pieces of good news. Which do you want to hear first?

spans.text: I have one piece of bad news and two pieces of good news. Which do you want to hear first?

units.displayText: Why does this sound so familiar... And why are there TWO pieces of good news?

spans.text: Why does this sound so familiar... And why are there TWO pieces of good news?

units.rawText: I'll start with the good news, then.
units.displayText: I'll start with the good news, then.

spans.text: I'll start with the good news, then.

units.rawText: The first piece of good news is that the Eosphorus fragment stabilized. The second piece of good news is that we no longer have to expend effort on pinpointing the neural cloud that's enmeshed with Eosphorus'.
units.displayText: The first piece of good news is that the Eosphorus fragment stabilized. The second piece of good news is that we no longer have to expend effort on pinpointing the neural cloud that's enmeshed with Eosphorus'.

units.rawText: Said neural cloud is disintegrating because it's been running in the background all this time and expending operands. It was simply covered up by other data before.
units.displayText: Said neural cloud is disintegrating because it's been running in the background all this time and expending operands. It was simply covered up by other data before.

units.rawText: In other words, your guess was right. The unusual circumstances of the Professor and the reason why you and Persicaria are unaffected by the defense systems are definitely related to that neural cloud.

units.displayText: Then, have you found any clues related to the Professor?

units.displayText: I have, and they were deliberately left by that neural cloud.

units.rawText: Then she wouldn't have needed to let Persicaria and myself leave safely. Of course, that's just one reason why I trust her.

spans.text: What's this... OPRF... The Ocean Policy Research Foundation ? Then what are those numbers, some kind of code?

units.rawText: It's an acronym for Oasis Professor, and that's the password for the Professor's admin account.
units.displayText: It's an acronym for Oasis Professor, and that's the password for the Professor's admin account.

spans.text: It's an acronym for Oasis Professor, and that's the password for the Professor's admin account.

units.rawText: Every time they dumped extra work onto me, I had to use that account and that password to open a new ticket, so I remember it very clearly.
units.displayText: Every time they dumped extra work onto me, I had to use that account and that password to open a new ticket, so I remember it very clearly.

spans.text: Every time they dumped extra work onto me, I had to use that account and that password to open a new ticket, so I remember it very clearly.

units.rawText: And that emoji at the end was me telling them that the password was too simple and that they should go change it up. It used to just be 123456.
